entities.label: Australian Privacy Principles
entities.description: A set of principles established to guide the management and protection of personal information in Australia.

entities.label: APP entities
entities.description: Organizations or agencies that are required to comply with the Australian Privacy Principles.

entities.label: personal information
entities.description: Any information that relates to an identified or identifiable individual, including sensitive information.

entities.label: unsolicited personal information
entities.description: Personal information received by an APP entity that was not actively sought or requested.

entities.label: government related identifiers
entities.description: Identifiers assigned by government agencies to individuals, such as tax file numbers or driver's license numbers.

entities.label: APP privacy policy
entities.description: A document that outlines how an APP entity manages personal information, including collection, use, and disclosure practices.

entities.label: direct marketing
entities.description: A form of communication aimed at promoting products or services directly to individuals using their personal information.

entities.label: cross-border disclosure
entities.description: The transfer of personal information from one country to another, particularly to entities not subject to the same privacy laws.

entities.label: sensitive information
entities.description: A subset of personal information that includes details such as health, racial or ethnic origin, and political opinions, which require higher protection.

entities.label: access to personal information
entities.description: The right of individuals to request and obtain their personal information held by APP entities.

entities.label: correction of personal information
entities.description: The process by which individuals can request changes to their personal information to ensure its accuracy and relevance.

entities.label: compliance
entities.description: The act of adhering to laws, regulations, and guidelines, particularly in relation to privacy principles.

entities.label: notification
entities.description: The process of informing individuals about the collection and use of their personal information.

entities.label: de-identification
entities.description: The process of removing or altering personal information so that individuals cannot be readily identified.

entities.label: inquiry or complaint
entities.description: A request for information or a report of dissatisfaction regarding the handling of personal information by an APP entity.

entities.label: overseas recipients
entities.description: Entities or individuals located outside of Australia that may receive personal information from APP entities.

entities.label: enforcement body
entities.description: An organization or agency that has the authority to enforce laws and regulations, particularly in relation to privacy and data protection.

entities.label: permitted general situation
entities.description: Circumstances under which the collection, use, or disclosure of personal information is allowed without consent under the Australian Privacy Principles.

entities.label: permitted health situation
entities.description: Specific conditions under which sensitive health information can be collected, used, or disclosed without consent.

entities.label: technical and organisational measures
entities.description: Strategies and actions taken by APP entities to protect personal information from unauthorized access and breaches.

entities.label: written notice
entities.description: A formal document provided to individuals explaining the reasons for refusal of access or correction of personal information.
